verdict.rationale: Gazebo is a locally run, open-source robotics simulator. It has no hosted production environment or production data that a separate sandbox or test mode would protect, so the sandbox-versus-production axis is a category error for this product type. Its headless server mode and simulated worlds are the simulator's core function, not a sandbox isolated from production data, so they are not credited here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
